requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Anonymous layer metadata returned. Safe schema inspection found OBJECTID, GlobalID, and other source fields; no unsafe fields were requested in feature queries.

Bounded envelope around the WUP point [-112.02,41.09,-111.99,41.12] returned three parcel polygons with only OBJECTID requested, transformed to EPSG:4326. Full unchanged response is in ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/layton/layton-query.geojson; no retained sample.

Exact WUP point [41.1024668531369,-112.008818127792] returned one intersecting parcel with OBJECTID 178267 and geometry; full response is in ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/layton/exact-query.geojson.
